description: This is a PHP source file defining the CustomerTransaction class in the OpenCart admin extension. It handles functionalities for viewing, saving, and generating reports related to customer transactions within the admin panel.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: Controller class managing customer transaction reports, including viewing, filtering, and saving report settings in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the customer transaction report page, loads language resources, sets breadcrumbs, and renders the report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of report configuration settings based on user permissions and request data, returning success or error as JSON.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates the customer transaction report, loads data, and renders the report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches and outputs the customer transaction report list in JSON format.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves filtered customer transaction data based on request parameters for display in the report list.
